title: rubia peregrina var. latifolia
intro: Rubia peregrina var. latifolia, commonly known as the Himalayan or Turkish Madder, is a plant species belonging to the Rubiaceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities. The plant's therapeutic actions include wound healing, anti-anxiety, and anti-depressive effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as alkaloids, phenolic compounds, and anthraquinones. The bioactive constituents of Rubia peregrina var. latifolia have been reported to include anthraquinones, such as rubiadin and rubiadin-1-methyl ether, which are responsible for the plant's medicinal properties.
